verses.en: Again, David gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.pt: E Davi voltou a juntar todos os escolhidos de Israel, trinta mil.
verses.en_web: David again gathered together all the chosen men of Israel, thirty thousand.
verses.en_bbe: And David got together all the fighting-men of Israel to the number of thirty thousand;

verses.en: And David arose, and went with all the people that were with him from Baale of Judah, to bring up from thence the ark of God, whose name is called by the name of the LORD of hosts that dwelleth between the cherubims.
verses.pt: E levantou-se Davi, e foi com todo o povo que tinha consigo, de Baal de Judá, para fazer passar dali a arca de Deus, sobre a qual era invocado o nome do SENHOR dos exércitos, que mora nela entre os querubins.
verses.en_web: David arose, and went with all the people who were with him, from Baale Judah, to bring up from there God’s ark, which is called by the Name, even the name of Yahweh of Armies who sits above the cherubim.
verses.en_bbe: And David, and all the people who were with him, went to Baal of Judah to get the ark of God, over which the holy name is named, the name of the Lord of armies, whose place is between the winged ones.

verses.en: And they set the ark of God upon a new cart, and brought it out of the house of Abinadab that was in Gibeah: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drave the new cart.
verses.pt: E puseram a arca de Deus sobre um carro novo, e levaram-na da casa de Abinadabe, que estava em Gibeá: e Uzá e Aiô, filhos de Abinadabe, guiavam o carro novo.
verses.en_web: They set God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house that was on the hill; and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, drove the new cart.
verses.en_bbe: And they put the ark of God on a new cart and took it out of the house of Abinadab which was on the hill: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were the drivers of the cart.

verses.en: And they brought it out of the house of Abinadab which was at Gibeah, accompanying the ark of God: and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.pt: E quando o levavam da casa de Abinadabe que estava em Gibeá, com a arca de Deus, Aiô ia diante da arca.
verses.en_web: They brought it out of Abinadab’s house, which was in the hill, with God’s ark; and Ahio went before the ark.
verses.en_bbe: And Uzzah went by the side of the ark, while Ahio went before it.

verses.en: And David and all the house of Israel played before the LORD on all manner of instruments made of fir wood, even on harps, and on psalteries, and on timbrels, and on cornets, and on cymbals.
verses.pt: E Davi e toda a casa de Israel dançavam diante do SENHOR com toda sorte de instrumentos de madeira de faia; com harpas, saltérios, adufes, flautas e címbalos.
verses.en_web: David and all the house of Israel played before Yahweh with all kinds of instruments made of cypress wood, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with castanets, and with cymbals.
verses.en_bbe: And David and all the men of Israel made melody before the Lord with all their power, with songs and with corded instruments and instruments of brass.

verses.en: And when they came to Nachon’s threshingfloor, Uzzah put forth his hand to the ark of God, and took hold of it; for the oxen shook it.
verses.pt: E quando chegaram à eira de Nacom, Uzá estendeu a mão à arca de Deus, e segurou-a; porque os bois a sacudiam.
verses.en_web: When they came to the threshing floor of Nacon, Uzzah reached for God’s ark, and took hold of it; for the cattle stumbled.
verses.en_bbe: And when they came to Nacon's grain-floor, Uzzah put his hand on the ark of God to keep it safe in its place, for the oxen were out of control.

verses.en: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against Uzzah; and God smote him there for his error; and there he died by the ark of God.
verses.pt: E o furor do SENHOR se acendeu contra Uzá, e feriu-o ali Deus por aquela imprudência, e caiu ali morto junto à arca de Deus.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Uzzah; and God struck him there for his error; and he died there by God’s ark.
verses.en_bbe: And the wrath of the Lord, burning against Uzzah, sent destruction on him because he had put his hand on the ark, and death came to him there by the ark of God.

verses.en: And David was displeased, because the LORD had made a breach upon Uzzah: and he called the name of the place Perez-uzzah to this day.
verses.pt: E entristeceu-se Davi por o SENHOR ter ferido a Uzá: e foi chamado aquele lugar Perez-Uzá, até hoje.
verses.en_web: David was displeased, because Yahweh had broken out against Uzzah; and he called that place Perez Uzzah, to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And David was angry because of the Lord's outburst of wrath against Uzzah: and he gave that place the name Perez-uzzah, which is its name to this day.

verses.en: And David was afraid of the LORD that day, and said, How shall the ark of the LORD come to me?
verses.pt: E temendo Davi ao SENHOR aquele dia, disse: Como há de vir a mim a arca do SENHOR?
verses.en_web: David was afraid of Yahweh that day; and he said, “How could Yahweh’s ark come to me?”
verses.en_bbe: And such was David's fear of the Lord that day, that he said, How may I let the ark of God come to me?

verses.en: So David would not remove the ark of the LORD unto him into the city of David: but David carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.pt: Não quis, pois, Davi trazer a si a arca do SENHOR à cidade de Davi; mas levou-a Davi à casa de Obede-Edom geteu.
verses.en_web: So David would not move Yahweh’s ark to be with him in David’s city; but David carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.
verses.en_bbe: So David did not let the ark of the Lord come back to him to the town of David: but had it turned away and put into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.en: And the ark of the LORD continued in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite three months: and the LORD blessed Obed-edom, and all his household.
verses.pt: E a arca do SENHOR esteve na casa de Obede-Edom geteu três meses: e abençoou o SENHOR a Obede-Edom e a toda sua casa.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s ark remained in Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house three months; and Yahweh blessed Obed-Edom and all his house.
verses.en_bbe: And the ark of the Lord was in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months: and the Lord sent a blessing on Obed-edom and all his family.

verses.en: And it was told king David, saying, The LORD hath blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that pertaineth unto him, because of the ark of God. So David went and brought up the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the city of David with gladness.
verses.pt: E foi dado aviso ao rei Davi, dizendo: o SENHOR abençoou a casa de Obede-Edom, e tudo o que tem, por causa da arca de Deus. Então Davi foi, e trouxe a arca de Deus de casa de Obede-Edom à cidade de Davi com alegria.
verses.en_web: King David was told, “Yahweh has blessed the house of Obed-Edom, and all that belongs to him, because of God’s ark.” So David went and brought up God’s ark from the house of Obed-Edom into David’s city with joy.
verses.en_bbe: And they said to King David, The blessing of the Lord is on the family of Obed-edom and on all he has, because of the ark of God. And David went and took the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the town of David with joy.

verses.en: And it was so, that when they that bare the ark of the LORD had gone six paces, he sacrificed oxen and fatlings.
verses.pt: E quando os que levavam a arca de Deus haviam andado seis desfiladeiros, sacrificavam um boi e um carneiro gordo.
verses.en_web: When those who bore Yahweh’s ark had gone six paces, he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf.
verses.en_bbe: And when those who were lifting the ark of the Lord had gone six steps, he made an offering of an ox and a fat young beast.

verses.en: And David danced before the LORD with all his might; and David was girded with a linen ephod.
verses.pt: E Davi saltava com toda sua força diante do SENHOR; e tinha vestido Davi um éfode de linho.
verses.en_web: David danced before Yahweh with all his might; and David was clothed in a linen ephod.
verses.en_bbe: And David, clothed in a linen ephod, was dancing before the Lord with all his strength.

verses.en: So David and all the house of Israel brought up the ark of the LORD with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.pt: Assim Davi e toda a casa de Israel levavam a arca do SENHOR com júbilo e som de trombeta.
verses.en_web: So David and all the house of Israel brought up Yahweh’s ark with shouting, and with the sound of the trumpet.
verses.en_bbe: So David and all the men of Israel took up the ark of the Lord with cries of joy and sounding of horns.

verses.en: And as the ark of the LORD came into the city of David, Michal Saul’s daughter looked through a window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before the LORD; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.pt: E quando a arca do SENHOR chegou à cidade de Davi, aconteceu que Mical filha de Saul olhou desde uma janela, e viu ao rei Davi que saltava com toda sua força diante do SENHOR: e menosprezou-lhe em seu coração.
verses.en_web: As Yahweh’s ark came into David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out through the window, and saw king David leaping and dancing before Yahweh; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.en_bbe: And when the ark of the Lord came into the town of David, Michal, Saul's daughter, looking out of the window, saw King David dancing and jumping before the Lord; and to her mind he seemed foolish.

verses.en: And they brought in the ark of the LORD, and set it in his place, in the midst of the tabernacle that David had pitched for it: and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the LORD.
verses.pt: Meteram, pois, a arca do SENHOR, e puseram-na em seu lugar em meio de uma tenda que Davi lhe havia estendido: e sacrificou Davi holocaustos e pacíficos diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: They brought in Yahweh’s ark, and set it in its place, in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and David offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And they took in the ark of the Lord, and put it in its place inside the tent which David had put up for it: and David made burned offerings and peace-offerings to the Lord.

verses.en: And as soon as David had made an end of offering burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD of hosts.
verses.pt: E quando Davi acabou de oferecer os holocaustos e pacíficos, abençoou ao povo no nome do SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of Yahweh of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: And after David had made the burned offerings and the peace-offerings, he gave the people a blessing in the name of the Lord of armies.

verses.en: And he dealt among all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, as well to the women as men, to every one a cake of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine. So all the people departed every one to his house.
verses.pt: E repartiu a todo aquele povo, e a toda a multidão de Israel, tanto a homens como a mulheres, a cada um uma torta de pão, e um pedaço de carne, e um frasco de vinho. E foi-se todo aquele povo, cada um à sua casa.
verses.en_web: He gave to all the people, even among the whole multitude of Israel, both to men and women, to everyone a portion of bread, dates, and raisins. So all the people departed, each to his own house.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave to every man and woman among all the people, among all the masses of Israel, a cake of bread and a measure of wine and a cake of dry grapes. Then all the people went away, every man to his house.

verses.en: Then David returned to bless his household. And Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel today, who uncovered himself to day in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovereth himself!
verses.pt: Voltou logo Davi para abençoar sua casa: e saindo Mical a receber a Davi, disse: Quão honrado foi hoje o rei de Israel, desnudando-se hoje diante das criadas de seus servos, como se desnudasse um vulgar!
verses.en_web: Then David returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Saul came out to meet David, and said, “How glorious the king of Israel was today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of the servants of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!”
verses.en_bbe: Then David came back to give a blessing to his family. And Michal, Saul's daughter, came out to him and said, How full of glory was the king of Israel today, who let himself be seen uncovered by his servant-girls like a foolish person uncovering himself without shame!

verses.en: And David said unto Michal, It was before the LORD, which chose me before thy father, and before all his house, to appoint me ruler over the people of the LORD, over Israel: therefore will I play before the LORD.
verses.pt: Então Davi respondeu a Mical: Diante do SENHOR, que me preferiu a teu pai e a toda sua casa, mandando-me que fosse príncipe sobre o povo do SENHOR, sobre Israel, dançarei diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: David said to Michal, “It was before Yahweh, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of Yahweh, over Israel. Therefore I will celebrate before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And David said to Michal, I was dancing before the Lord, who put me over your father and all his sons, to make me a ruler over the people of the Lord, over his people Israel: and I will go on playing before the Lord;

verses.en: And I will yet be more vile than thus, and will be base in mine own sight: and of the maidservants which thou hast spoken of, of them shall I be had in honour.
verses.pt: E ainda me farei mais vil que esta vez, e serei baixo em meus próprios olhos; e diante das criadas que disseste, diante delas serei honrado.
verses.en_web: I will be yet more vile than this, and will be worthless in my own sight. But of the servants of whom you have spoken, they will honor me.”
verses.en_bbe: And I will do even worse than this, and make myself even lower in your eyes: but the servant-girls of whom you were talking will give me honour.

verses.en: Therefore Michal the daughter of Saul had no child unto the day of her death.
verses.pt: E Mical filha de Saul nunca teve filhos até o dia de sua morte.
verses.en_web: Michal the daughter of Saul had no child to the day of her death.
verses.en_bbe: And Michal, Saul's daughter, had no child till the day of her death.
